#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
exec >>/bench/run.log 2>&1
{ date -u --iso-8601=seconds; uname -a; lscpu; free -m; df -h /; } > /bench/host.txt
finish() { code=$?; trap - EXIT; printf '%s\n' "$code" > /bench/exit-code; timeout 600 /bin/bash /bench/pack.sh || true; exit "$code"; }
trap finish EXIT
IFS= read -r scope < /proc/self/cgroup
case "$scope" in
  0::*/corten-bench-groups-r21-d170147514518ef2.service/supervisor) parent="/sys/fs/cgroup${scope#0::}"; parent="${parent%/supervisor}" ;;
  0::*/corten-bench-groups-r21-d170147514518ef2.service)
    parent="/sys/fs/cgroup${scope#0::}"
    while IFS= read -r member; do test "$member" = "$$"; done < "$parent/cgroup.procs"
    mkdir "$parent/supervisor"
    printf '%s' "$$" > "$parent/supervisor/cgroup.procs"
    ;;
  *) exit 2 ;;
esac
test -d "$parent" && test ! -L "$parent" && test ! -L "$parent/supervisor"
while IFS= read -r member; do test -z "$member"; done < "$parent/cgroup.procs"
IFS= read -r controllers < "$parent/cgroup.controllers"
for controller in cpu cpuset memory pids; do
  case " $controllers " in *" $controller "*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
done
printf '%s' '+cpu +cpuset +memory +pids' > "$parent/cgroup.subtree_control"
IFS= read -r controllers < "$parent/cgroup.subtree_control"
for controller in cpu cpuset memory pids; do
  case " $controllers " in *" $controller "*) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
done
while IFS= read -r member; do test "$member" = "$$"; done < "$parent/supervisor/cgroup.procs"

timeout 900 cloud-init status --wait
systemctl disable --now apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer || true
timeout 900 systemd-run --quiet --property=After=apt-daily.service --property=After=apt-daily-upgrade.service --wait /bin/true
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
timeout 900 apt-get update -qq
timeout 900 apt-get install -y -qq software-properties-common curl ca-certificates build-essential
# https://git-scm.com/install/linux: Ubuntu's upstream stable Git PPA.
# Distribution Git may lack --no-lazy-fetch; never weaken immutable native queries.
timeout 900 add-apt-repository --yes ppa:git-core/ppa
timeout 900 apt-get update -qq
timeout 900 apt-get install -y -qq git
timeout 30 git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch --version >> /bench/host.txt
timeout 900 bash -o pipefail -c 'curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh'
timeout 900 bash -o pipefail -c 'curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_26.x | bash -'
timeout 900 apt-get install -y -qq nodejs
node -e 'if (process.versions.node.split(".")[0] !== "26") process.exit(1)'
systemctl enable --now docker
export GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1
timeout 600 git -c core.autocrlf=false clone --quiet --no-checkout 'https://github.com/corten-run/corten.git' '/bench/repo'
cd '/bench/repo'
test "$(git config --get remote.origin.url)" = 'https://github.com/corten-run/corten.git'
timeout 600 git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
git merge-base --is-ancestor '9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970' 'origin/main'
git -c core.autocrlf=false checkout --detach '9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970'
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
{ printf 'source-url=%s\n' 'https://github.com/corten-run/corten.git'; printf 'source-commit=%s\n' '9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970'; git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}'; } >> '/bench/host.txt'
test "$(nproc)" -ge 8
timeout 900 npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
timeout 900 npm --prefix bench/browser ci --no-audit --no-fund
timeout 900 npx --no-install playwright install --with-deps chromium
timeout 900 docker pull node:26.13.1-bookworm-slim@sha256:5df79989ed685e09f0a98019db4cebfb22fb9df1a53c0161664a011f7ff6b0f1
timeout 900 bash -o pipefail -c 'curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal'
export PATH=/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH
{ docker --version; node --version; npm --version; rustc --version; cargo --version; } >> /bench/host.txt
# The entry derives all nine groups and their native settings from this measured source.
# Popular/performance views reuse the same evidence; no second workload execution.
unset BENCH_APPS BENCH_TIER BENCH_EDGE PROFILE
mkdir -m 700 -- '/bench/campaign'
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
node --input-type=module -e 'import { writeFileSync } from "node:fs"; writeFileSync("/bench/bootstrap-ready.json", "{\"schema\":\"benchmark-common-bootstrap/v1\",\"round\":\"r21\",\"commit\":\"9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970\",\"token\":\"d170147514518ef2\",\"group\":\"mixed-production\"}\n", { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 });'
node 'bench/workloads/isolated/campaign-entry.mjs' 'r21' --commit '9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970' --state-dir '/bench/campaign' --group 'mixed-production'
files.pack.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
cd '/bench'
for file in 'run.log' 'host.txt' 'exit-code'; do test -f "$file" && test ! -L "$file"; done
if test -e 'results.tgz' || test -L 'results.tgz'; then
  test -f 'results.tgz' && test ! -L 'results.tgz'
  test "$(stat -c '%s' -- 'results.tgz')" -le 19327352832
  exit 0
fi
if { test ! -e 'campaign' && test ! -L 'campaign'; } || { test -d 'campaign' && test ! -L 'campaign' && test -z "$(ls -A -- 'campaign')"; }; then
  /usr/bin/timeout 25 /usr/bin/python3 - <<'CORTEN_SETUP_PACKAGE'
import os, pathlib, re, stat
root = pathlib.Path('/bench')
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and root.resolve() == root
marker = root / 'bootstrap-ready.json'
if os.path.lexists(marker):
    info = marker.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_size <= 1024
    assert marker.read_bytes() == "{\"schema\":\"benchmark-common-bootstrap/v1\",\"round\":\"r21\",\"commit\":\"9f3d35884c67d90524f978d173fabeb3a17bc970\",\"token\":\"d170147514518ef2\",\"group\":\"mixed-production\"}\n".encode('ascii')
campaign = root / 'campaign'
if os.path.lexists(campaign):
    assert campaign.is_dir() and not campaign.is_symlink() and next(campaign.iterdir(), None) is None
size = 0
for name in ['run.log', 'host.txt', 'exit-code']:
    info = (root / name).lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1
    size += info.st_size
    assert size <= 17179869184
marker = root / 'exit-code'
assert marker.stat().st_size <= 16
value = marker.read_bytes()
assert re.fullmatch(rb'[1-9][0-9]{0,2}\n', value) and int(value) <= 255
CORTEN_SETUP_PACKAGE
else
  node --input-type=module -e 'import { checkPackage } from "/bench/repo/bench/workloads/cloud-local.mjs"; checkPackage("/bench");'
fi
stage=$(mktemp '/bench/cloud-pack.XXXXXXXX')
trap 'rm -f -- "$stage"' EXIT
files=('run.log' 'host.txt' 'exit-code')
test ! -e 'campaign' || files+=('campaign')
tar --format=gnu -czf "$stage" -- "${files[@]}"
test "$(stat -c '%s' -- "$stage")" -le 19327352832
ln -- "$stage" 'results.tgz'
rm -- "$stage"
trap - EXIT
